fix: Allow zero `--phase` arguments when `--predates` is nonempty, and test the all-started case.
text: `init` requires a `--phase`, but `/plan` §5.6.2a directs it to create a table with only `--predates` when every phase has started. That self-heal path always exits with a usage error.

fix: Define and implement a verification path for commitless phases that does not require an invented commit range.
text: Commitless phases retain a Verify task and receive a judge row, but `judge.py prepare` requires a nonempty commit range for every row’s repo. `/verify` therefore stops before judging these phases.

fix: Make the gate require review records covering each declared code repo and revision range before accepting Done.
text: The new workflow promises review before Done, but `verdict-gate.py` checks dispositions only if a review log exists. A code phase with passing finish rows and no `/review` run can be marked Done.

fix: Return structured block reasons with each unit, then use those reasons for the retry decision.
text: The requested `--all --json` output puts only check IDs in each unit’s `blocks`. It never puts `no final verdict` or `an unfinished run` there, so the prescribed test cannot identify units that need `/verify` before archive.

fix: Deduplicate index paths and count only scopes with at least one gated unit whose `--all` verdict passes.
text: `gate-count` treats an archived scope as clean solely because its index rows lack ⚠. It does not check a passing verdict or even require a gated row, so an all-predating or unverified table can advance the five-scope blocking threshold. Passing an index explicitly alongside `--discover` can count it twice.

fix: Require readable raw judge output for a run judged by a model; return an evaluation error when it is missing.
text: If a finalized judged run’s raw judge JSON is missing, `collect` silently uses `{}` and drops every judge-named lever candidate, while closeout can report that there are none.

fix: Reject lever candidates whose `check_id` is absent from `check_ids`.
text: Judge-produced lever candidates are checked for `lever_id` shape, but their `check_id` is not checked against this run’s checks. An invented ID can enter the TO-DO ledger with `Touches: ?` and be counted as a later sighting.

fix: Track the time of a successful `origin main` fetch specifically, or fetch that ref on every check.
text: `FETCH_HEAD` can be refreshed by a fetch of another branch. The script then skips fetching `main` and can print nothing while `origin/main` is stale, contrary to its freshness claim.

fix: Change the threshold here to five.
text: This live skill instruction still says the advisory gate lasts until three clean scopes; the configured threshold and the other updated instructions say five.

fix: Record a phase-start base for the repo and require zero commits in base..HEAD; fail when the base or count is unavailable.
text: For a commitless unit with no recorded base, --no-commits skips the range check entirely. Commits made in the row's repo can therefore be judged without a diff or a required review.

fix: Block on None with the git error; skip only a confirmed count of zero.
text: A failed git rev-list returns None and is treated as zero commits. The mandatory-review check silently skips a repo or base it cannot evaluate.

fix: Require the reviewed head to be on the current branch and require a later review covering each fixed blocking finding's commit.
text: Review coverage only checks that the reviewed head follows the unit base. A review on a discarded branch, or one preceding a blocking finding's fix, can satisfy the gate while the relevant commits remain unreviewed. The latter contradicts /plan §6.8.

fix: Handle stamp-write errors and continue to the revision count; a failed cache write need not discard a successful fetch.
text: An unwritable stamp raises an uncaught OSError after a successful fetch, so this startup check exits nonzero before reporting freshness despite its stated never-fail contract.

fix: Parse --predates before this check and require at least one parsed phase or predating unit.
text: A blank or comma-only --predates value passes this truthiness check but parses to no units. init then succeeds with a table containing neither gated nor predating phases.

reason: A commit-less phase's judge rows point at the docs repo, which always carries progress commits, so 'record a base and require zero commits' would fail every commit-less phase. Code repos are visible only through declared --repo bases (/plan §5.13 requires one before a repo's first commit), and --no-commits is already refused when any declared base has commits in range (5.3-r1-02). An undeclared repo is outside what any range check can see.

fix: Use lstat() to reject symlinks, validate the stamp contents, and add a test for a fresh symlinked stamp.
text: isfile() follows symlinks. A stamp symlink to a recently modified regular file is treated as proof of a fetch, so the script skips fetch and can silently report a stale clone as current.

fix: Emit one combined line, or update both callers to display every output line.
text: An unwritable stamp now produces a warning before the behind-clone line, but plan/SKILL.md §6.7 and verify/SKILL.md §2.0.1 still instruct agents to show “that line” in the singular. Showing only the first line hides the actionable stale-clone warning.

reason: The stamp lives in the clone's own .git dir and only this script writes it. Anything able to plant a symlink there can equally rewrite refs/remotes/origin/main, which no freshness check can defend against; lstat() would add a check without adding protection. The failure modes that occur without tampering (another branch's fetch, a non-file at the path, an unwritable stamp) are fixed in r1-08, r3-01 and r3-02.
